clusters.headline: President Trump Declares Iran Conflict Effectively At An End
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump stated that military operations against Iran have effectively concluded, leading to a decrease in global oil prices.
Ongoing maritime instability persists, with reports of twenty-five seafarer deaths and multiple cargo vessels missing since February.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
